newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's AMP to make major announcement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's AMP to make major announcement.

text.p: The Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP), Australia's largest insurer and investment group, said it would make a major announcement later on Thursday.
A spokeswoman said Managing Director George Trumbull would hold a news conference in Sydney at 2.00 p.m. (0300 GMT).
AMP was due to hold a board meeting on Wednesday and was expected to discuss the possible demutualisation and float of the group.
The spokewoman declined to comment on the reason for the news conference.
